title: browser-check private config (ego lite)
description: Lives in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/config.json (0600, parent 0700). `browser-check.mjs setup` writes it; `setup --migrate` replaces an old Aside (schemaVersion 1) file. Unknown keys are rejected.

ego.description: Either bin (ego lite on this machine — the PC) or remoteHost (a server: the PC over ssh, through the browser_check relay).

bin.description: absolute path to ego-browser.exe (setup prefers ~/.local/share/ego/active_version_dir, which follows ego updates)

remoteHost.description: ssh Host of the PC (key login); the relay must be installed there (`relay install`)

relayEntry.description: the PC path of the relay entry, as the PC's cmd.exe sees it

relayDir.description: the PC relay folder (setup reads it from the relay); window.ps1 there reopens a closed ego window minimized

settleMs.description: how long bc.finish waits for 0 requests in flight before it leaves the space open instead of closing it

light.description: force prefers-color-scheme: light in bc.prep (ego's own theme can be dark)

sites.description: Per-site rules. setup never guesses them; without a rule the safe defaults apply.

guardWrites.description: turn the in-page write guard on for this site

writeAllow.description: paths the guard lets through — on a logged-in site include its token-refresh path, or the page falls back to its login screen
